subject: Action: Vendor onboarding — Helios Devices COI, E&O & cyber evidence + PO steps
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Rao <asha@helios-devices.com>, Tim O'Neil <tim.oneil@helios-devices.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Action: Vendor onboarding — Helios Devices COI, E&O & cyber evidence + PO steps

Hi Asha / Tim —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for the device telemetry pilot. We're starting the procurement onboarding checklist so we can issue a PO and complete vendor setup in our systems. To keep the timeline tight, please could you provide the following by end of day Wednesday (PST):

- Certificate of Insurance (COI) for General Liability naming Redwood Inference, Inc. as additional insured; minimum $1M per occurrence / $2M aggregate.
- Errors & Omissions (E&O) policy summary (coverage limits and policy number).
- Cyber liability / data breach certificate showing at least $1M cyber coverage.
- Completed vendor setup form (I attached the spreadsheet template).
- Completed W-9 (if US entity) or VAT form for non-US.

Notes / next steps once we have docs: Rafael will request final PO approval; Marissa will start the account creation and supply-chain entry. If there are any gaps in coverage we can route to legal for a limited-risk acceptance, but prefer to have standard limits.

Attachments: Vendor-Onboarding-Checklist.xlsx (xls, 1 page)

Appreciate a quick confirmation of ETA.

Best,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Sr. Vendor Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
---
Redwood Inference — procurement team
From: Asha Rao <asha@helios-devices.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tim O'Neil <tim.oneil@helios-devices.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Action: Vendor onboarding — Helios Devices COI, E&O & cyber evidence + PO steps

Hi Laura —

Thanks — confirming receipt. Please find attached the initial COI for General Liability and our cyber certificate. E&O is handled through our parent insurer; I included a one-page policy summary and the W-9 as requested.

Quick clarifications:
- GL COI lists Redwood Inference, Inc. as additional insured and should meet the limits you requested (see Helios_COI_GeneralLiability.pdf).
- Cyber certificate is an insurer-issued statement (Helios_Cyber_Certificate.pdf) — it notes $1M limit and retroactive coverage.
- E&O: summary attached (Helios_EO_Policy_Summary.pdf). If you need the full policy we can route a redacted version via secure link.
- W-9: Helios Devices LLC (Helios_Signed_W9.pdf).

Let me know if Rafael or Marissa need anything else to move the PO forward. We're aiming for a September 1 start date on the pilot.

Best,
Asha Rao
Procurement Lead | Helios Devices
asha@helios-devices.com
Attachments: Helios_COI_GeneralLiability.pdf (pdf, 1 page); Helios_Cyber_Certificate.pdf (pdf, 1 page); Helios_EO_Policy_Summary.pdf (pdf, 2 pages); Helios_Signed_W9.pdf (pdf, 1 page)
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2026 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Action: Vendor onboarding — Helios Devices COI, E&O & cyber evidence + PO steps

Laura / Marissa —

Received Asha's package and reviewed the attachments. Quick notes:
- GL COI: insurer and limits are OK; need additional insured endorsement scanned (it's referenced but not visible on the COI). I've asked Asha to confirm and upload the endorsement.
- Cyber certificate: fine, please ensure the retroactive date is listed in the record we store.
- E&O summary: acceptable for a pilot; legal says if we scale we'll request the full policy.
- W-9: good.

Marissa — I'll need a PO request created in Coupa with the following fields:
  - Vendor: Helios Devices LLC
  - Address: 2412 Harbor Blvd, Suite 300, Richmond, CA 94801
  - Tax ID: 12-3456789 (from W-9)
  - Invoice terms: Net 30
  - SOW: Pilot telemetry ingestion — up to $45k

I can draft the PO justification language if you want. Once Coupa request is submitted I'll attach the COI and certificates and route for approvals. Asha — if you can send the additional insured endorsement and the insurer contact for certificate validation, that will close the loop.

Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Procurement Operations | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Rao <asha@helios-devices.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2026 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Action: Vendor onboarding — Helios Devices COI, E&O & cyber evidence + PO steps

Thanks everyone —

Asha: appreciate the fast turnaround. I've started the vendor record in our internal portal and created the Coupa PO draft (PROC-712). Rafael, I copied the draft justification below — feel free to edit before I submit for approval:

PO justification (draft):
Redwood will engage Helios Devices LLC to ingest device telemetry for pilot integration. Estimated spend not to exceed $45,000; vendor provides device management telemetry data to our ingestion pipeline for testing and evaluation. Standard terms, Net 30. Insurance evidence provided (GL, E&O summary, Cyber coverage).

Next steps for Asha: please upload the additional insured endorsement and insurer contact to the secure folder or reply-all with the endorsement attachment.

Asha — once we receive the endorsement I will attach all docs to PROC-712 and submit for procurement approval (est. 2–3 business days). Tim — if your team needs any special invoicing instructions please confirm so I can set them on the PO.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Vendor Onboarding Specialist | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Attachment: Coupa-PO-Draft-PROC-712.pdf (pdf, 1 page)
